items.title: Executive Assistant - LATAM
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs moves fast - and behind every high-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high-trust, hands-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier - down to the small, considered details that others overlook. You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership - managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day-to-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most. In this role, you will: - Manage complex, fast-moving calendars and provide scheduling and coordination support across multiple time zones and geographies - Handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion, acting as a trusted partner in both professional and operational contexts - Coordinate seamlessly with internal stakeholders across teams, as well as external partners and senior leaders - Work closely with other EAs across the organisation to align schedules, share context, and keep cross-functional coordination running smoothly - Anticipate needs before they arise: managing follow-ups, flagging conflicts, and keeping the right people aligned - Build structure, processes, and systems that scale with a fast-growing AI company - Identify opportunities to automate and streamline repetitive work, using AI tools and productivity tooling to improve quality and speed Requirements - Proven experience supporting senior leaders and their broader teams in a fast-moving environment, including coordinating with other EAs across the organisation - Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and partners to vendors and office guests - High emotional intelligence and discretion - trusted with sensitive information - Comfortable supporting not just an individual but a wider team at times - able to flex between high-priority senior leadership support and broader operational needs as the situation demands - Personable and easy to work with - someone who builds genuine relationships across the organisation and is trusted by the people around them - A natural reflex to reach for tooling and automation; fluency with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT and quick to adopt new systems - High personal standards - the kind of person who cares about the quality of their output and holds the bar - A valid passport and willingness to travel globally ~40% of the time - Language requirement: Fluent in English and Spanish (written and spoken). Proficiency in Portuguese is a plus. Location This role is based in Mexico or São Paulo #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Financial Crimes (FinCrimes) Sanctions team plays a critical role in protecting Robinhood and its customers by identifying, investigating, and mitigating sanctions-related risks across our products and global operations. The team supports a rapidly evolving business, including cryptocurrency, brokerage, and money movement activities, while maintaining compliance with applicable U.S. and international sanctions requirements. As a Sanctions Crypto Investigator you will be responsible for investigating potential sanctions exposure associated with cryptocurrency transactions, digital asset wallets, and customer activity. You will leverage blockchain analytics, investigative tools, and sound risk-based judgment to identify potential sanctions violations, assess complex transaction activity, and document defensible investigative conclusions. This role is based in our Denver, CO, Westlake, TX, or New York NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Conduct thorough investigations of cryptocurrency-related sanctions alerts, including customer screening matches, deposits, withdrawals, wallet addresses, and blockchain transactions. Leverage blockchain analytics tools, including TRM Labs or similar platforms, to evaluate direct and indirect sanctions exposure, trace transaction activity, and identify potential sanctions evasion typologies. Review and disposition potential matches against OFAC and other applicable sanctions lists, ensuring timely, accurate, and well-documented investigative decisions. Identify and escalate potential sanctions violations, including transactions or assets that may require blocking, rejecting, or additional regulatory review. Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive investigative narratives, supporting documentation, and escalation recommendations. Monitor emerging cryptocurrency sanctions risks, regulatory developments, and illicit finance typologies to support ongoing risk identification and mitigation. Partner with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Product, and other FinCrimes teams to resolve complex investigations and enhance sanctions screening capabilities. Identify opportunities to improve investigative workflows, screening effectiveness, operational efficiency, and automation. Assist with regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, quality assurance reviews, and management reporting. Maintain adherence to established procedures, regulatory requirements, and internal service-level expectations while managing investigative workloads. What you bring 3+ years of experience in financial crimes, sanctions investigations, AML compliance, or a related field within financial services, fintech, cryptocurrency, or another regulated environment. Demonstrated experience investigating cryptocurrency transactions and assessing financial crimes or sanctions-related risks. Working knowledge of blockchain technology, digital asset transactions, wallet addresses, and cryptocurrency transaction flows. Experience using blockchain analytics tools such as TRM Labs, Chainalysis, Elliptic, or comparable platforms. Strong understanding of OFAC sanctions regulations, sanctions screening requirements, and common sanctions evasion methodologies. Experience conducting complex investigations, evaluating potential true positive matches, and preparing clear, defensible investigative documentation. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex information and make sound, risk-based decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate investigative findings and recommendations effectively. Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain a high degree of accuracy in a fast-paced environment. A collaborative mindset and willingness to partner across teams to solve problems and improve existing processes. High standards of integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. items.title: ElevenMusic - Content Creator & Strategist
items.location_text: United States, Dublin, Europe, Japan, Mexico, Italy, Poland, United Kingdom, Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE ElevenMusic is our AI music creation platform, letting anyone turn an idea into a finished, studio-grade track in minutes, with control over genre, mood, structure, and vocals across multiple languages. It is one of the most exciting parts of the ElevenCreative suite, and we want its voice, community, and content presence to match the ambition of the product. We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own how ElevenMusic shows up in the world. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Create educational content and tutorial videos around ElevenMusic, recording, editing, and formatting them natively for each platform, and publish them across our socials - Make music with ElevenMusic constantly, testing the platform to its limits and turning experiments into content that shows creators what's possible - Provide structured, high-signal product feedback to the engineering team based on deep daily use, helping shape the roadmap - Own and manage the ElevenMusic social accounts, from content calendar and strategy through to publishing, engagement, and analytics - Help build and grow a community around ElevenMusic, sparking conversation, surfacing creator feedback, and championing standout work - Speak at creator events, representing ElevenMusic through talks, demos, and workshops - Plan and execute content around product launches and feature releases, coordinating with product, engineering, and Marketing - Stay ahead of trends in music creation, AI tools, and platform culture to find opportunities for the brand REQUIREMENTS - Demonstrated experience creating music and music-related content, with a portfolio of work you can share, you are a genuine music maker, not just a marketer - Proven ability to produce educational content and tutorial videos end-to-end: recording, editing, adding text and motion, and formatting natively for platforms like X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube - Experience managing social media accounts for a technology, music, or creative tools company, including content calendars, copywriting, and analytics - Comfortable presenting publicly, speaking at events, running demos or workshops, and being a visible face for the product - A genuine understanding of the AI and music creation landscape, you use the tools, follow the space, and have informed opinions about where things are headed BONUS - Experience building or growing a creator community (Discord, forums, or similar) - Background as a working musician, producer, or music educator with an existing audience - Experience giving product feedback or working closely with engineering/product teams - Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar) - Multilingual capabilities GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Lead content and community strategy across ElevenMusic as the product and team scale - Move into a broader creative or content role spanning video, editorial, and social across ElevenLabs brands - Expand into creator partnerships, evangelism, or brand marketing as the growth team evolves LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Data Annotation Specialist - German Writer/Translator
items.location_text: Canada, Calgary, Boston, Nashville, Richmond, Phoenix, Seattle, United States, Vancouver, North America | Utah, Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal
items.description: Who are we? Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Why this role? We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans - by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting text output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech. Cohere seeks dynamic and dedicated Data Annotators with exceptional Modern Standard German Writing, Translation, and Data Manipulation skill. Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada. We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 30 CAD/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). Remote work within Canada. 12 months contract. Performance incentives included! As a Data Annotation Specialist, you will: - Label and Rank: Accurately label and rank machine learning data with advanced proficiency in German, ensuring data integrity and quality. - Audit and Correct: Scrutinize and rectify any inaccuracies in language data (may include text, image, JSON, TSV/CSV, Markdown), maintaining the highest standard of data accuracy. - Reading and Text-Based Tasks: Efficiently complete reading and text-based assignments, with high attention to detail. - Preference-Based Tasks: Evaluate and complete tasks, assessing which responses in German best conform to project guidelines. - Recommend Optimizations: Identify and suggest opportunities for improving data quality and model performance in German language tasks. - Provide Feedback: Collaborate and communicate effectively, providing feedback to cross-functional team members, particularly on German language-related matters. - Detail-Oriented Execution: Maintain meticulous attention to detail while performing repetitive and precise tasks, particularly when working with language data. You may be a good fit if you have: - Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in German; excellent command over English. - Expert reading and writing skills - which you are ready to prove on our written test. - Basic familiarity with JSON/TSV/CSV/Markdown data manipulation. - Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy - you’re the type to proofread all of your emails! - High tolerance for repetitive and monotonous work. - Ability to follow complex instructions, navigate ambiguity and work independently. - Superb sense of urgency and time management. - Curiosity about technology and a knack for tackling problems in creative ways. - A reliable laptop. The Candidate Journey: Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples. Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more. Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team! Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor. It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week. Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material. If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

items.title: Design Engineer
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Design Engineer to join our core product engineering team. You'll sit at the intersection of product design and frontend engineering, owning the craft and polish of the Glean experience end to end. This is a rare role: beyond hands-on UI work, you'll build an AI-forward design system — encoding our design language as rules, components, and agent-consumable skills so that every engineer (and every coding agent) at Glean ships products that look and feel world-class. You'll partner closely with our design team while reporting into engineering. You will: Design and build polished, high-craft product experiences across Glean's web, desktop, and mobile apps — from micro-interactions and motion to full feature surfaces Evolve Glean's design system: components, tokens, usage rules, and documentation Make our design system AI-ready — author the rules, linting, and guidelines that let AI coding agents correctly use design-system components and follow best practices Build a "product design skill" for coding agents, encoding Glean's design judgment so quality scales with every engineer shipping product Set the bar for frontend craft on the team through prototypes, code review, and hands-on collaboration with designers and engineers Rapidly prototype interaction and motion concepts to resolve design questions in code rather than specs About you: 5+ years of experience spanning product design and frontend engineering (or exceptional depth in one with strong fluency in the other) Expert in modern web UI: TypeScript, React, CSS; strong instincts for motion, interaction detail, and accessibility Experience building or maintaining a design system at scale — components, tokens, governance, and adoption Excited about AI-assisted development; you've used coding agents and have opinions on how to make them produce high-quality UI A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual and interaction craft Self-directed: you identify polish gaps and fix them without waiting for a spec Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in either our San Francisco or Mountain View office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $115,000 - $190,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

items.title: Customer Experience Associate, Money
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Money Customer Experience team is responsible for providing our customers with the best experience possible while using our product. We collaborate closely within the team, leadership, and other support functions to ensure our customers have the best experience with our products and the services we offer. We serve as dedicated customer advocates, actively highlighting key product features and benefits to continually enhance and advance our services. We also build and maintain the tools necessary to provide exemplary service in each interaction. Our high-performing team is dedicated to supporting customers and ensuring their satisfaction! As a Customer Experience Associate with Money , you will serve as a subject matter expert on our Credit Card and Banking products and customer support processes. You will be the front-line expert responsible for assisting our cardholders with their most challenging inquiries. In this role, you will independently navigate complex inquiries, leveraging your subject matter expertise, departmental guidelines, and a compassionate, empathetic approach to resolve cardholder concerns with care and efficiency. Your work will directly impact customer trust and help drive the long-term success of our financial products! This role is based in our Denver, CO, and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 6-week onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Bring deep customer empathy and a passion for providing exceptional customer service to every cardholder. Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to remain adaptable as support processes evolve. Investigate details independently, escalate issues appropriately, and identify emerging trends that may indicate product bugs. Learn and grow continuously as our banking and credit card services expand. Act as an advocate for our products and services, driving continuous improvement based on customer feedback. What you bring Possess 1+ years of customer service, financial services or contact center support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education. Demonstrate a basic understanding of financial products, or a strong willingness to learn about them. Show familiarity with text, email, and phone-based customer support channels. Apply basic working knowledge of Salesforce or similar customer relationship management (CRM) platforms. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more! Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 2 compensation zones. This role is also eligible to participate in a Robinhood bonus plan. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

You'll lead the development of high-availability services which provide novel certificate needs internally and with external partners. items.title: Corporate Paralegal
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally. This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible. WHAT YOU'LL DO 1. Cap Table & Share Register Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential. 2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record. 3. Insurance & Document Management Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity. 4. Procurement Contracts First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work. WHAT YOU BRING - 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups). - Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40). - Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates. - Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally. - Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration. - Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH). - Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms. - Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding. - Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). items.title: Principal, Product Analytics
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business. We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey. You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Go looking for what nobody asked about. This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging. - Lead deep investigations into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales. - Find where activation breaks. Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities. - Understand acquisition and intent. Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve. - Do rigorous causal and statistical work. Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support. - Build models that drive action. Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have. - Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data. Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data. - Size opportunities. Produce market opportunity sizing that helps the business prioritise. - Measure how we build. Partner with engineering managers on organisational productivity metrics. - Communicate for impact. Translate findings into clear recommendations for product teams, management and executives. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR MUST-HAVES - Deep product analytics experience across growth and broader product areas, with a record of investigations that changed decisions. - Data science and modelling experience, and the ability to explain how you applied it and what business impact it had. - Strong grounding in correlation, regression and causal analysis. - A proactive approach. You surface insights and shape the agenda rather than working to a brief. - Genuine curiosity. You notice what looks off and dig until you understand why. - Clear communication with management and executives about business impact, simplifying complex analysis into actionable recommendations. PREFERRED - Experience with unstructured data. - Experience at an AI-native company, or with the added data complexity AI products bring. - Understanding of subscription businesses. - Understanding of the PLG motions in a B2B space. BONUS POINTS IF YOU'VE… - Worked on multi-product platforms where upsells, cross-sells and bundling were a key revenue driver. - Worked alongside qualitative research, connecting the what (data) with the why (qual). - Done pricing and packaging work: willingness-to-pay, price testing, bundle performance. - HOW WE WORK We optimise for responsibility and freedom. - No ticket conveyor belt. We run on ownership and a small number of high-impact projects. - Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Growth and commercial teams to ship real outcomes. - A bias toward pragmatic solutions that get used, measured and improved. WHY JOIN - Do the hardest, most interesting analytical work in the company, with direct line of sight to product and strategy decisions. - Work across structured and unstructured data, customer conversations and AI evaluation, at the intersection of product usage, AI and revenue. - Independence and impact at principal level, without the management overhead.

items.title: Frontier Agent Engineering Manager, Enterprise
items.description: About Scale AI Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI initiatives through our data annotation platform, generative AI solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities. Role Overview As a Forward Deployed AI Engineering Manager on our Enterprise team, you'll be the technical bridge between Scale AI's cutting-edge AI capabilities and our most strategic customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to understand their unique challenges, lead a team that architects specific AI solutions, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of AI systems in production environments. This is a Management role that combines deep engineering and AI expertise, leading a team, and working on customer-facing problems. You'll work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate AI into their critical workflows. Key Responsibilities Customer Integration & Deployment Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their technical infrastructure, data pipelines, and business requirements Design and implement custom integrations between Scale AI's platform and customer data environments (cloud platforms, data warehouses, internal APIs) Build robust data connectors and ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and prepare customer data for AI workflows Deploy and configure AI models and agents within customer security and compliance boundaries AI Agent Development Develop production-grade AI agents tailored to customer use cases across domains like customer support, data analysis, content generation, and workflow automation Architect multi-agent systems that orchestrate between different models, tools, and data sources Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance and iterate toward business objectives Design human-in-the-loop workflows and feedback mechanisms for continuous agent improvement Prompt Engineering & Optimization Create sophisticated prompt engineering strategies optimized for customer-specific domains and data Build and maintain prompt libraries, templates, and best practices for customer use cases Conduct systematic prompt experimentation and A/B testing to improve model outputs Implement RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems and fine-tuning pipelines where appropriate Leadership & Collaboration Serve as the Engineering Manager and technical point of contact for strategic enterprise accounts Lead a team that is collaborating with customer data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers to ensure smooth integration Work closely with Scale's product and engineering teams to translate customer needs into product improvements Document technical architectures, integration patterns, and best practices Problem Solving & Innovation Debug complex technical issues across the entire stack, from data pipelines to model outputs Rapidly prototype solutions to unblock customers and prove out new use cases Stay current on the latest AI/ML research and tools, bringing innovative approaches to customer problems Identify opportunities for productization based on common customer patterns Required Qualifications 5+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ yrs of Management experience with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design Production Python expertise with experience in modern ML/AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace, OpenAI API) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern data infrastructure Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and rapidly iterate toward solutions Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences Preferred Qualifications Agent Development Wiz Deep understanding of LLMs including prompting techniques, embeddings, and RAG architectures Experience building and deploying AI agents or autonomous systems in production Knowledge of vector databases and semantic search systems Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects Infrastructure Guru Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines Experience using Terraform, Bicep, or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools Previous work in a devops, platform, or infra role Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) Customer Product Whisperer Proven ability to work with customers in a technical consulting, solutions engineering, or product engineering role Domain expertise in verticals like finance, healthcare, government, or manufacturing Experience with technical enablement or teaching programs Sample Projects The following are some examples of the types of projects we’ve worked on with customers. All of these projects leverage customer data, integrate directly into customers’ existing systems, and are deployed on their infrastructure. Deep Research for Due Diligence For a global professional services firm, we developed a sophisticated deep research agent to assist in due diligence. This agent employs a multi-agent architecture for robust fact-checking, integrates several internal MCP tools, and processes complex, unstructured data sources. This solution reliably saves employees hundreds of hours weekly. Churn Prediction Working with a TelCo organization, we built a model utilizing customer data to predict churn likelihood. The system then curates personalized offers based on this prediction. This model was integrated into a "next best action" copilot, enabling call center agents to proactively surface relevant offers to customers, leading to a significant reduction in churn. Data Extraction Voice Agent We partnered with a healthcare organization to create a lifelike voice agent and avatar designed to gather unstructured health information from patients. Engineered for low latency, the agent adeptly manages conversational flow, adheres to safety guardrails, and efficiently handles data extraction. This automation saves the organization's nurses hundreds of hours each week. Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend. Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco and New York is: $227,000 — $325,000 USD PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. items.title: Solutions Engineer
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. The Role We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function in North America. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building while scaling, we’d love to hear from you. As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product. This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across North America. What You’ll Do - Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges. - Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product. - Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia’s platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value. - Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution. - Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward. - Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy. - Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies. - Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally. - Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface. - Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp. We’d love to hear from you if you have - 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience). - Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell). - Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer’s use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires. - Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned. - Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect. - Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization. - Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly. - Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines. - Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed. - You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development. - Strong written and spoken communication in English. We’d be particularly excited if - You have previous experience as an AE. - You have experience with video AI. Location We're looking for someone based in NYC for this role, who can commit to 2+ days a week in-office. Compensation We’re hiring Solutions Engineers across a range of experience levels and expect to pay between $171,609 and $222,502 OTE (on-target earnings), split 70% base / 30% variable, with the variable portion paid quarterly.

items.title: Principal Designer, Otherlife
items.description: Otherlife is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. Otherlife is MoonPay's creative studio. We design how brands meet the next era of the internet, working with companies like Mastercard, Arsenal FC, Coinbase, OpenSea, and Shopify on the brand identities, digital experiences, and on-chain products that introduce real people to emerging tech. Our work sits at the intersection of culture, design, and technology, and the bar is clarity, craft, and work that holds up long after the launch. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're making emerging tech feel intuitive, accessible, and worth using, for humans and agents. MoonPay made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, and made The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. Reporting to Executive Creative Director Nick Ace, you will lead concepting, design, and execution hands-on across brand, product, AI video, and GTM work, setting the standard for craft and quality through the work itself. This is not a people-management role. You will mentor and support designers through design reviews, feedback, and guidance on 1-2 team members, but most of your time goes to doing the work. Key Responsibilities Own top-priority MoonPay and Partner projects end to end, from concept through delivery. Lead creative for key launches and GTM campaigns, contributing original ideas and hands-on design. Work across brand, product, motion, and AI video to deliver cohesive, multi-disciplinary work. Partner with the Executive Creative Director to uphold Otherlife’s design standards and visual identity. Mentor designers through design reviews, feedback, and guidance. Collaborate with project managers, strategists, and developers for efficient delivery. Present creative work to stakeholders, clients, and partners. Stay current on design trends, tools, and AI workflows, and bring them into the team’s process. Required Skills & Experience 7+ years of professional design experience, ideally in a creative or digital agency, with a strong portfolio of high-profile work. Experience working within web3, blockchain, fintech, AI or emerging tech companies. Proven ability to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects as a hands-on contributor. Experience creating broadcast-quality advertisements using AI-driven design tools and traditional methods. Strong command of branding, digital design, UX/UI, motion, and visual storytelling. Experience with design systems and scalable visual frameworks. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain creative rationale to stakeholders and clients. Strong organization and attention to detail under tight deadlines. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, plus familiarity with WebGL, GSAP, or Three.js. Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Graphic Design, Digital Media, or a related field. Nice to Have Experience developing AI-driven automation for creative automation. 3D and motion tools (After Effects, Cinema 4D, Blender). Informal mentorship or team-lead experience. Familiarity with agile, cross-functional workflows across design, engineering, and strategy. Otherlife Perks Competitive salary based on experience, market data, and location. Share options. Health & dental benefits. Access to exclusive industry events. New York Salary Bandings: $358,000 - $367,500 USD Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. You’ll ship features that integrate tightly with our AI-driven audio models, and work out where focused bets or incremental improvements will move the product most. items.description: About the Role Lead OpenAI’s field delivery of civil works, structures, building envelope, architectural fit-out and landscape interfaces, from site preparation through completed facilities. You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for civil, structural, landscape and architectural construction, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan. Reporting and scope Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Coordinate design interpretation and technical decisions with the responsible civil, structural and architectural engineers. Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners. This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities. Key Responsibilities - Direct and coordinate general contractors, civil and structural trades, architectural contractors and specialist service providers against the approved design, construction schedule and quality requirements. - Oversee earthworks, grading, drainage, underground interfaces, foundations, concrete, structural steel, building envelope and architectural completion; coordinate landscape and external works. - Review constructability, work sequencing, contractor work plans, RFIs, submittals and proposed changes; obtain design decisions from the responsible engineers and track field implementation. - Coordinate building and underground interfaces with mechanical, electrical and network leads and hardware deployment teams, protecting access, equipment routes and installation readiness. - Inspect work with quality teams, track nonconformances and punch lists, and verify contractor closeout, as-built records and turnover readiness. - Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager. - Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams. Qualifications - Typically 8–10 years of civil, structural or architectural construction experience, including substantial data center or comparable complex industrial site delivery and responsibility for contractors or multiple work packages. Equivalent depth of practical delivery experience will be considered. - Ability to read and coordinate civil, structural and architectural drawings, specifications, surveys and relevant geotechnical information, recognizing impacts on grading, drainage, earthworks, foundations, underground services and building construction. - Experience translating approved designs into buildable field packages, sequencing, temporary-work interfaces and inspection hold points; assess utility conflicts, equipment access and phased handover before releasing work. - Experience reviewing RFIs, submittals and field changes, coordinating design decisions with the engineer of record, and verifying approved changes in the field while preserving clear design responsibility. - Practical knowledge of inspection and acceptance evidence for civil works, concrete, steel, building envelope and architectural completion, including nonconformance resolution, punch lists and as-built records. - Ability to coordinate construction with permitting conditions, environmental constraints and authorities having jurisdiction through the responsible engineering and EHS teams. - Demonstrated ability to lead contractors and service providers through changing site conditions, set clear deliverables and acceptance criteria, and resolve performance gaps across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority. - Strong written and verbal communication: maintain accurate field records, action and decision logs, and explain technical risks, schedule impacts and recovery options to site leadership, engineers and delivery partners. - Sound judgment when information is incomplete: identify assumptions, prerequisites and interfaces, determine what work can proceed within approved authority, and escalate unresolved risks before they affect safety, quality or delivery. - Relevant trade, apprenticeship, technical or degree-based preparation, or equivalent practical experience. items.title: Compliance & Governance Specialist
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re bringing our governance, risk and compliance approach to life, and this role is where it gets practical. You’ll work with business leaders to turn requirements into controls that work, test how well they hold up and close the gaps, while leaders stay accountable for their obligations. It’s hands-on assurance across our service lines and corporate functions, inside a business that moves fast. What you’ll build with us: You’ll help shape how obligations, controls, risks and evidence connect across Easygo, from the GRC system that links them to the policies, registers and reporting around it. You’ll also explore and apply AI and automation to make everyday compliance processes more efficient, consistent and effective, working alongside Legal, Finance, ESG data owners and external advisers. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Maintain our corporate function obligations registers (People & Culture, Finance, IT and Legal & Compliance), prioritise assurance requirements and map them to controls with the right stakeholders, keeping them across their obligations as requirements change. Document and improve controls to address gaps, test their design and operating effectiveness under the agreed assurance plan, and track remediation through to closure, including follow-up testing where required. Manage Gifts & Benefits and Conflicts of Interest submissions and registers, and coordinate vendor due diligence, escalating findings under the agreed methodology. Administer our GRC system, from access and workflows to data quality and the links between obligations, controls, risks, evidence and actions, and prepare the dashboards and reports that come out of it. Support risk assessments, maintain risk registers and assist with framework and methodology updates under the Lead’s direction. Maintain the Legal & Compliance policy register and review schedule, coordinating drafting, approvals, version control and publication with policy owners and Legal. Coordinate ESG reporting timelines and information requests with Finance, business data owners and external advisers, and support disclosure drafting, including climate-related. Explore and apply AI and automation to make everyday processes more efficient, consistent and effective. Your track record: 3–5 years’ relevant experience in governance, risk, compliance or assurance, ideally within the gaming or a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. Experience maintaining obligations and controls documentation, reviewing evidence and identifying gaps. The ability to translate requirements into practical processes and controls, with sound judgement on when specialist advice or escalation is required. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, managing registers, evidence, reviews and competing deadlines. Clear written and verbal communication, working collaboratively across departments and following through on agreed actions. The ability to work independently within agreed priorities and authority, and to spot practical process improvements. Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve efficiency, with the curiosity to experiment, build repeatable workflows and critically assess outputs. You can share practical examples of efficiencies you’ve achieved. Bonus points if you also have: Experience administering GRC systems (Protecht is highly regarded), conducting controls testing or managing policy lifecycles. Experience managing vendor due diligence, Gifts & Benefits or Conflicts of Interest processes. Experience in a regulated, technology or online entertainment business. Exposure to ESG reporting, data collection or assurance, including working with business data owners and external advisers. If you deliver, you move. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

This role will move across Critical Harm priorities as needs evolve. You may step into operationalizing national security or violent-activities workflows, support wellbeing and Frontier Risk initiatives, or help scale programs such as Trusted Access.
